ui.note: NDTI is a relative index: comparable only within one sub-reach, never NTU. An anomaly is a departure from the sub-reach's own baseline, never evidence that any actor caused anything.

sources.title: magdalena-puerto-wilches-01
sources.text: Contracted period of maintenance dredging of the Magdalena navigation channel in the Barrancabermeja-Pinillos/Barranquilla sector (about 640 km), which contains the reach. No source found names which crossings were dredged, or when.

sources.title: magdalena-puerto-wilches-02
sources.text: A Cormagdalena dredge lent for about three months to the Sitio Nuevo sector of Puerto Wilches for a dike-breach emergency was reported withdrawn (article of 7 May 2023); about 370 of 460 m of the work was reported done.
